learning_outcomes.text: To provide information about the types of heat exchangers used in industry.
To provide students with information about the design and applications of heat exchangers.
To inform about thermal calculations of heat exchangers for industrial applications.
To teach design parameters for heat exchangers.
To provide students with experience in the selection, sizing, and thermal design of heat exchangers.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to course content, resources, and methods
Thermal design methods of heat exchangers
Convection relations in single-phase flow regions of heat exchangers
Fouling and deposits in heat exchangers
Pressure drop and pump power calculation in heat exchangers
bibliography: Heat Exchangers: Selection, Rating and Thermal Design, Sadık Kakaç, H. Liu, CRC Press, 2nd ed., 2002.
